news.title: Linta P Jose and Shaju Thomas completed the acquisition of 60% stake in Hari Govind International Limited from Sunita Maniyar and Jugal Kishore Maniyar.
news.body:
Linta P Jose and Shaju Thomas agreed to acquire 60% stake in Hari Govind International Limited from Sunita Maniyar and Jugal Kishore Maniyar for INR 30 million on May 14, 2025. A cash consideration of INR 30 million valued at INR 10 per share will be paid by Linta P Jose and Shaju Thomas. As part of consideration, INR 30 million is paid towards common equity of Hari Govind International Limited.

The transaction is subject to approval of merger agreement by target board. The deal has been approved by the board of Hari Govind International Limited.

Linta P Jose and Shaju Thomas completed the acquisition of 60% stake in Hari Govind International Limited from Sunita Maniyar and Jugal Kishore Maniyar on February 14, 2026.

news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: Following the recent departure of a director, there are only 3 independent directors on the board. The company's board is composed of: 3 independent directors. 4 non-independent directors. Independent Director Rishin Rasheed was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2025. The company's minority of independent directors is a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.title: Hari Govind International Limited Appoints Mr. Abhilash Thekkumpurath As Chief Financial Officer, Effective February 7, 2026
news.body: Hari Govind International Limited announced the appointment of Mr. Abhilash Thekkumpurath (PAN: AOMPT0471L) as the Chief Financial Officer of the Company designated as the key managerial person of the Company with effect from February 7, 2026. Mr. Abhilash Thekkumpurath holds a Master’s Degree in Commerce (M.Com) from the University of Calicut. He has over 15 years of professional experience in the field of Finance and Accounts, covering financial planning and analysis, accounting, budgeting, statutory and regulatory compliances, internal controls, and financial reporting. He has over 11 years of experience in managing finance and accounts functions within the textile manufacturing sector.
